note: TransformerPath listed census of transformer component and material suppliers (bushings, OLTC, insulation, oil, radiators, copper, CRGO, monitoring, test equipment, and related accessories). This is a growing, sourced directory — not a complete worldwide catalogue. China, India, Türkiye and other large markets still have many additional workshops that are not yet listed. Group brands that live on a parent website (for example CEDASPE on reinhausen.com, GIPRO under PREIS) are listed under the parent, not as a separate supplier. Every entry records a country and an official website where known. Verification reflects a website check or an official-site listing on the recorded date; entries do not imply endorsement or a complete product-line audit. Sources: existing accessories.json; unused in-repo research in scratch/generate_accessories.js (2026-09-10); data/components-deep-dive.json (2026-09-11); 2026-09-13 sourced pass adding public Chinese, Indian, Turkish and European accessory firms with official websites. 2026-09-13 sourced pass: IEEMA member-directory component firms with official websites, plus unused deep-dive suppliers.
